title: Moving
excerpt: My better half has been accepted to UC Davis, and we’ll be moving there in the next few days. We are pretty excited; I think Davis will be a better place to raise our son. It’s also closer to the Sierra, so I’ll have the chance to spend more time in the backcountry.
